text.tspan: SQSO-HW-DIAG-001 · drawn from the build-to netlist SQSO-OBC-BRD-001 (hardware/electrical/obc) · pins: SQSO-ICX-001 D section 4 · flags name the nets of W3, W4, W5, W8, W9 and sheets S6-S9
D2 TVS, C1 22 uF, C2 10 uF; 100 nF at each of the 9 VDD, 2 VDDIO2, VDDUSB and VBAT pins (13).
VBAT tied to VDD: the mission clock is U4 on the always-on rail. Inrush 1.0 ms at SW10's 0.13 A limit.
FRAM SPI1 (CS# PG5 U3, PD7 U36)
GSE plug ties pin 9 to pin 1: UMBILICAL_SENSE high = present (key loading).
U36 FM25V20A mirrors every U3 record: SPI1 shared, CS# PD7 (10k up), WP#/HOLD# pulled up (SMA-B10).
ESD: TPD4E05U06-Q1 at every connector (J1 x7, J2 x3, J3, J5, J8 x2, J9 x2, J10).
